Vote - AcceptText - SB XX 15016.5 shows a similar peculiar upsilon, which should now be put in the text. No diaeresis there, and we can leave it out here, though I see what was taken as such. I propose to emend: <:ἐμοῦ Ματ̣[o]ι̣=L. Vanderheyden (from image)|ed|(ἐμο(ῦ)) (Κ̣ο̣μα[σίο(υ)]):>

Vote - AcceptText - The new reading looks pretty good to me. The way the final upsilon of emou is formed strikes me as slightly odd. The first curve of the my is also curved in a different way from the instance of the same letter in emou. The rest is easier to verify, although I am not entirely convinced about the diaeresis on the final iota. After another pair of eyes has looked I would be happy to accept the new reading.
